messages:
Anya: heads up — apac-south just hit a provisioning loop, GPUs boot but never register with the control plane, seen since 09:12 UTC :frowning:
Ravi: saw that too, kubelet failing at bootstrap when trying to decrypt node token. getting KMS AccessDenied on our keystore key
Beck: did we roll the new VPC MFA/SourceIp constraint last night? I remember a policy tweak in the keystore hardening PR
Anya: yes, merged 02:05 UTC. security wanted stricter `aws:SourceIp` constraints for keystore:Get*
Ravi: problem is our warmpool/provisioning uses ephemeral NATs and occasionally hops AZs — SourceIp check is brittle
infra-bot: alert: apac-south: node.join.failures > 25% over 10m — paging eng-platform on-call
Anya: immediate mitigation idea: add an explicit allow for the provisioning NAT CIDR used by warmpool for 2h while we build a proper fix
Beck: we already tried a manual restart of the init container on some nodes — a few succeeded after restart, so the failure is deterministic during initial decrypt calls
security-bot: recommendation: use a time-limited policy exception with tagged justification and a revert job. Also consider switching to `aws:SourceVpc` or `aws:SourceVpcArn` conditions instead of IPs to avoid NAT churn issues
Ravi: I'll author a small patch to the keystore IAM condition to include the warmpool CIDRs. We'll also create an automation to revert in 1h.
Anya: please annotate in audit channel and attach the policy diff. need a CC to compliance for the exception
Ravi: patch command: `aws iam put-policy --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333:policy/keystore-read --policy-document file://keystore-allow-provisioning.json`
Ravi: patch snippet: "Condition": {"IpAddress": {"aws:SourceIp": ["13.240.10.0/24","13.240.11.0/24"]]}}
Beck: good. also add `kms:ViaService` to restrict to the KMS service principal and a resource constraint to the bootstrap key only
infra-bot: deploy-bot: policy patch applied at 09:28 UTC to prod(canary)
Anya: monitoring — provisioning queue started to drain within 6m, join failures decreased to ~5%
Ravi: cost note: if we left this for 4h we'd hit approximately $15k extra ephemeral spend. patched within 16m saved most of it
Beck: follow-ups: 1) replace SourceIp check with VPC condition in a safe staged rollout 2) add a canary test that simulates NAT churn during bootstrap in staging 3) update runbooks to record this class of failure
security-bot: logged incident `INC-2026-03-22-APAC-KEYS` and scheduled 1hr post-incident review with compliance
Anya: thanks all. I'll create the postmortem entry with timeline and assign owners. closing thread :white_check_mark:
